page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, place the instance in the lower 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression performing in the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores compensate in parallel workloads, achieving average tier results in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads remains in the average range, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1.7xlarge offers high compute density for parallelized tasks without the premium of high-capacity memory configurations. It is best suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage the 32 dedicated cores, such as static web serving, multi-threaded decompression, and moderate database operations. It is less optimal for single-threaded applications or memory-intensive databases due to its lower single-core performance and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio.
